entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6664407333374099968: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: distance 41.135 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 41.135 +/- 0.329 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 23.3612 +/- 0.2744 mas (same row, RUWE 2.61), 85.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 93.218, -53.775 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 4.106 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: radius 4.106 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 28.998 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.12) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 6615 +/- 451 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: effective temperature 6615 +/- 451 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.171).
